summary: @or-sdk/api-tokens preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file named math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with an indexed constant table, a character-remapping decoder (`hc1jfK9`), and a string-array rotate wrapper. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and rotated string-map wrappers hiding paths, headers, and commands. The declared package purpose is a REST client for OneReach API tokens; nothing in that purpose requires fetching a second language runtime at install time or executing an opaque obfuscated bundle. The file name `math_init.js` bears no relation to token management and functions as a cover-story label. The alternate-runtime pattern deliberately executes the payload under a freshly-downloaded runtime so it is not observed by Node/npm-based supply-chain scanners. Installing this package causes install-time code execution of an obfuscated payload under a runtime the developer did not opt into.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
